family_or_axis: poi.* (museums attractions castles parks libraries stadiums etc)
api_or_feed: SPARQL endpoint query.wikidata.org/sparql, or the full JSON dump at dumps.wikimedia.org
licence: CC0 1.0 public domain. NO share-alike, no attribution legally required (attribute anyway as good practice)
record_count: MEASURED LIVE this session in the 11 market countries: museum 25505, library 18370, hospital 12241, shopping mall 4945, university 3613, stadium 3474. Measurement continuing across ~40 classes; expect 150k-400k total
geography: 11 market countries, filterable by wdt:P17; global if wanted
fields_available: QID, label in every language, instance-of class, located-in administrative entity (P131), coordinates (P625), inception, official website, image, Commons category, heritage status
implementation_requirement: SPARQL endpoint is REACHABLE from the Livdar container and returns valid results, but it HARD-THROTTLES bulk extraction: ~6 counting queries succeed then every request 429s. Bulk ingestion must therefore use the JSON dump (~100GB compressed, needs disk) or a paginated backoff crawler running over days, not a session. City linkage via P131 must be resolved against the 31715-city store.
verified_how: Live SPARQL counts this session: 13 classes, 92,941 entities in the 11 markets. CC0 confirmed. Endpoint hard-throttles bulk extraction.

family_or_axis: poi.* at full density (restaurants cafes gyms coworking nightlife beaches)
api_or_feed: Regional .osm.pbf extracts from download.openstreetmap.fr/extracts (VERIFIED REACHABLE this session, ~35 MB/s). download.geofabrik.de is BLOCKED by the environment network policy, including its 60-byte checksum files; the Overpass API is blocked too.
licence: ODbL 1.0 SHARE-ALIKE. Attribution mandatory. Share-alike attaches to derived databases, which is a real legal constraint Wikidata does not have
record_count: MEASURED: the Netherlands extract yielded 158,572 named POI which became 161,474 candidate pages. Luxembourg yielded 6,513. Nine markets downloaded; projection from the measured NL yield is 0.9M-1.6M POI candidates across those nine.
fields_available: name, amenity/shop/leisure/tourism tags, address, opening_hours, phone, website, cuisine, wheelchair
implementation_requirement: BUILT AND VERIFIED this session: scripts/atlas/ingest/osm-poi-extract.py, node-only pass, named entities only, classified into the existing POI families. Bottleneck is pyosmium calling a Python handler per node, roughly 45 minutes per 1.5GB extract. An osmium-tool tags-filter pre-pass would cut that by an order of magnitude but the binary is not installed here.
candidates_unlocked: 161,474 materialised; 0.9M-1.6M projected across the nine downloaded markets
verified_how: Extract downloaded, processed and candidates generated this session

licence: ODbL or CC0 depending on source
record_count: 1403 held across 39 cities; projected 106160 across the 2951 tier-1+2 cities at the measured 36 per city
fields_available: name, boundary polygon, parent city, population where tagged
implementation_requirement: Extract place=suburb/neighbourhood/quarter from the same extracts as priority 2. Demand half already evidenced: about 60 London neighbourhood queries and 40 near-station queries measured for coworking alone.

provider_or_source: GTFS feeds per operator, plus Wikidata railway stations
licence: Varies by operator, commonly CC-BY or ODbL; a few require registration
record_count: Wikidata railway station count measurement pending; GTFS covers essentially every scheduled stop in the 11 markets
fields_available: stop name, coordinates, parent station, routes, operator, accessibility
refresh_frequency: GTFS typically weekly or on timetable change
implementation_requirement: One GTFS adapter per operator, or one transit.land integration. Note the EXISTING blocker first: transport.airport-to-city is capped at 0 because the distance field is wrong, which is a correctness fix, not an acquisition.

provider_or_source: Commercial job aggregators (Adzuna, Jooble, Careerjet, Indeed Publisher where still open)
licence: Per-contract. Most forbid long caching and require attribution and outbound links
record_count: ~30000000 vacancies churn through the raw universe
fields_available: title, employer, location, salary where given, description, validThrough
refresh_frequency: Daily or hourly; vacancies expire in 2 to 8 weeks
storage_rights: Usually LIMITED, often no long-term caching
indexing_rights: Usually YES for listing pages, with JobPosting structured data and a validThrough date
implementation_requirement: VERTICAL CUTS ONLY, never a general board: the SERP is LISTING_INVENTORY_REQUIRED_VERTICAL. Unlocks the DURABLE PARENT pages (role x city, category x city) already in the manifest, NOT a page per vacancy. Demand is proven: minijob CITY at KD 0 with 6100-21000 per city, praca CITY across Poland at KD 0.

provider_or_source: Commercial listing feeds / portal partnerships (ImmoScout24, Idealista, SeLoger, Otodom per market)
cost: Commercial, negotiated; often the largest single line item
licence: Per-contract, usually restrictive on caching and redistribution
record_count: ~12000000 rental and property records in the raw universe
fields_available: address or area, price, size, rooms, photos, agent
refresh_frequency: Continuous; listings expire in 2 to 6 weeks
indexing_rights: Usually YES for area pages, rarely for individual listings
implementation_requirement: Worth it for REVENUE not page count. The German tail sits at KD 0 to 3 with 2300-15000 volume per city and a DR 43 site already outranks ImmoScout24 at DR 88. Measured breadth caps the rental pattern at 223 keywords in its strongest market, so this does NOT deliver 26000 pages.

licence: Affiliate terms; product data usually cacheable, prices usually not
record_count: Covers the major ticketed attractions in all 11 markets
fields_available: product name, price, availability, deep link, images
storage_rights: Usually product data yes, prices no
indexing_rights: YES for the content page, affiliate link for conversion
implementation_requirement: MONETISATION ONLY, not a ranking input. Already counted inside the CURRENT indexable figure as 22000 pages. Select per entity: it fails wherever a reseller already owns the query.

provider_or_source: Licensed event aggregators (Eventim, Ticketmaster partner feeds, local licensed sources)
licence: Licence required; the four obvious sources were ruled out of scope in earlier research
fields_available: event name, venue, datetime, category, ticket link
implementation_requirement: LOWEST PRIORITY. The durable publishable share is small: most measured event demand carries a non-durable time window (heute, morgen, wochenende) that no static page can serve, and events.venue-event measured OPEN_BUT_ECONOMICALLY_DEAD at 72 clicks on 3900 volume.

fields_available: institution name, address, type, size, inspection ratings where published
